notes:
Document: 2022 Geological Sciences Major Map, B.S., 3 PDF pages (page 3 is only the tail of the Codes legend + signature, no table content).

PAGE BREAK / HEADER ISSUE (the reason this doc was chosen): the semester table starts on page 1 with the column header (Critical | Course Subject and Title | Credit Hours | Min. Grade | Major GPA | Code | Prerequisites | Notes) printed once. Page 1 runs through "Semester One" .. "Semester Six" .. "Summer (4-6 Credit Hours)" (with its single GEOL 500 row). Page 2 then opens directly with "Semester Seven (15 Credit Hours)" and "Semester Eight (12 Credit Hours)" — the header row is NOT reprinted before these two sections. Below Semester Eight on page 2 (same page) comes the Graduation Requirements Summary table, footnotes 1-9, Program Notes, University Requirements paragraph, and the start of the Codes glossary table (continuing onto page 3) — all of which I excluded per instructions (only semester tables included). Note also that the Read-tool output for page 2 gave the plain-text extraction of the trailing summary/footnote/codes content BEFORE the embedded page image in the payload, even though visually (per the image) that material sits BELOW the Semester Seven/Eight tables on the actual page. I trusted the image's visual top-to-bottom order (Seven, Eight, then summary material) since that's how the physical page is laid out.

STACKED CODE CELLS: two rows have two Code values stacked on separate lines within one cell rather than an inline value: ENGL 102 (Semester Two) shows "CC-CMW" then "CC-INF" on the next line, and GEOL 500 (Summer) shows "MR" then "CC-INT" on the next line. I joined these with "/" (top-to-bottom order) as "CC-CMW/CC-INF" and "MR/CC-INT" respectively, matching the convention implied by the task's own example value "MR/CC-INT" (which is in fact this exact GEOL 500 row). Other rows with slash-joined codes (e.g. "PR/CC", "CR/CC", "CC/PR") already print the slash inline on one line, so those needed no interpretation.

VERBATIM TYPO PRESERVED: the MATH 122/141 prerequisite text (Semester One) reads "MATH 111/111I/115" with an uppercase I, while the PHYS 201/211 prerequisite text (Semester Three) reads "MATH 111/111i/112/115/116/122/141" with a lowercase i. This inconsistency appears to be in the source document itself; I transcribed both exactly as printed without normalizing the case.

Footnote digits fused directly to titles with no space, preserved verbatim: "Calculus I3", "Field Geology9(summer only)" (note: no space at all before the parenthesis here, unlike other "(fall only)"/"(spring only)" instances elsewhere which do have a preceding space), "Cognate Course6", "Foreign language5", "Carolina Core Requirement4", "History7", "Approved Elective8".

No row in this document carried a Notes-column entry (rightmost column was blank throughout), so no row-level "notes" content exists to report — this is separate from the top-level total_credits_required field, which comes from the excluded Graduation Requirements Summary table's "Minimum Total Hours" value (120) and is reported only in the program metadata, not as a section/row.

Only two rows carry the "!" critical marker in this entire document: ENGL 101 (Semester One) and ENGL 102 (Semester Two). All other rows are critical=false.
